title: EOS test layers and wall-clock budgets
description: Declares which test files make up each layer and how long that layer may take. Consumed by .github/eos/run-tests.mjs. A declared file that does not exist is an ERROR, so a renamed or deleted suite cannot silently stop running.

defaultScale.description: Multiplier applied to every budget. Overridden by EOS_TEST_BUDGET_SCALE. Scale for a slow runner instead of raising individual budgets, so a breach keeps meaning the same thing everywhere.

coverage.description: Thresholds for `run-tests.mjs --coverage`. Enforced natively by Node 22+; on older versions the report still prints and run-tests says the threshold was not applied rather than implying a pass.

exclude.description: Globs excluded from the measurement — the tests themselves and their harnesses, which would otherwise inflate the number with code that exists to exercise other code.

layers.description: Layer name -> definition. Every file in a layer runs in ONE `node --test` invocation so Node parallelises them across cores.

budgetMs.description: Wall-clock ceiling for the layer. Set it around 2.5x the observed time: high enough to ignore normal variance, low enough that a 2x regression fails the build.
